requirements_summary: Customer is migrating a latency-sensitive chat assistant and a real-time reranker for trading desk workflows. Key asks: guaranteed baseline throughput for peak trading windows, predictable concurrency limits to avoid noisy neighbor effects, and a clear burst policy that allows >2x short spikes during market open without surprise charges. Must support VPC private deployment with KMS-backed keys and audit logs. Interested in reserved capacity with optional burst credits.
technical_notes: Workload profile: 70% chat (avg 80 tokens), 20% embeddings (batch), 10% rerank (short seqs)
Target latency SLOs: p50 < 60ms, p95 < 250ms for generation up to 64 tokens when served from dedicated pool
Throughput ask (proposed by customer): min 3,000 tokens/sec sustained during trading hours; concurrency cap 120 active sessions; burst allowance 6,000 tokens/sec for 5 minutes (market open/close)
Reserved GPU planning: initial ask = 8xA100 (or equivalent mixed with 16xA10G for <p95 SLAs) with autoscale buffer of +2 GPUs for headroom
Batching note: customer will enable prefix caching for high-reuse prompts; wants guidance from Redwood Optimize for batching windows
Fallback policy: route to smaller quantized variant if latency > SLO for >3 min — acceptable if quality delta < 6% on reranking accuracy
Billing preference: hybrid reservation + burst credits model; request example amortized cost per token at baseline and burst tiers
negotiation_points: Min tokens/sec: customer insists on contractual 3k tokens/sec during 08:00-16:00 EST trading window
Concurrency cap: propose hard cap 120, Redwood suggests soft cap with throttling and prioritized queues
Burst policy: customer requests free bursts up to 2x baseline for 10 minutes; Redwood proposes burst credits pool (prepaid) or tiered overage rates
SLA credits: dispute over credit calculation method (per-minute vs per-hour window) — customer prefers per-minute granularity
Reserved GPU commitment: negotiation between 8xA100 committed vs mixed fleet commitment to reduce cost
poa_next_steps: AE to propose two commercial options: (A) Fixed reserve 8xA100 + small burst credits pool; (B) Mixed reserve 12xA10G with automatic burst autoscale and higher overage rates
SE to run targeted throughput test on dedicated 8xA100 topology with realistic traffic (script + Fireflies ff-10021)
Legal to review SLA wording on burst and credits; draft targeted amendment for per-minute crediting
